summary.overview: In a recent Client Relationship Management meeting, Sian Finn and Natalie Leaf from Goodfoot engaged with Andy Day from Capital A Group to discuss their ongoing partnership and marketing strategies. Goodfoot, a leadership and management training company with over 20 years of experience, serves a range of corporate clients, while Capital A Group, an M&A advisory firm, aims to enhance the services previously provided by Daniel's business, now rebranded as DLA Engines. The meeting highlighted a review of email marketing performance, revealing declining reply rates that were addressed after fixing a throttling issue. They discussed the potential for improving response rates through Slack communication and a new monthly meeting cadence to align on strategies. Action items included scheduling future meetings and utilizing Slack for real-time communication to streamline collaboration and enhance marketing effectiveness.
summary.short_summary: Sian Finn and Natalie Leaf from Goodfoot engaged with Andy Day from Capital A Group in a meeting focusing on their partnership and marketing strategies. Goodfoot, a leadership and management training company with over 20 years of experience, serves diverse corporate clients and is adjusting its marketing tactics. The meeting highlighted a review of email marketing performance, revealing a decline in reply rates from 0.3% to 0.1%, which was attributed to a throttling issue that has since been resolved. They discussed improving response rates through Slack communication and a new monthly meeting schedule to align on strategies. Action items included scheduling future meetings and utilizing Slack for real-time communication to streamline collaboration and enhance marketing effectiveness.
